answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 112 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an ember bet on surviving 112 epochs of grading, and every lagoon settlement recomputes the river schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
